items.name: INV_BILL_ID1
items.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where nvl(effect, 0) = 1 order by trns_type_code

items.name: INV_BILL_ID2
items.lov: select trns_serial || ' - ' || to_char(trns_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') || ' - ' || doc_no d, trns_serial r from st_trns_mast where trns_type_code = :PAGE_INV_BILL_ID1 and (supplier_code = :PAGE_SUPPLIER_ID or :PAGE_SUPPLIER_ID is null) and nvl(delete_flag, 0) = 0 order by trns_date desc, trns_serial desc

fills.sql:
select to_number(:PAGE_INV_BILL_ID1) bill_id1, to_number(:PAGE_INV_BILL_ID2) bill_id2, it.item_group_code group_code,
       it.item_code, it.item_code || ' - ' || it.name_a item_code__d, 0 disc_ratio, 0 disc_value, max(m.supplier_ref) supplier_ref
  from st_item it, st_trns_det dt, st_trns_mast m
 where nvl(it.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and dt.group_code = it.item_group_code and dt.item_code = it.item_code
   and m.trns_type_code = dt.trns_type_code and m.trns_serial = dt.trns_serial
   and nvl(dt.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and nvl(m.delete_flag, 0) = 0
   and dt.trns_type_code = to_number(:PAGE_INV_BILL_ID1) and dt.trns_serial = to_number(:PAGE_INV_BILL_ID2)
   and not exists (select 1 from vn_subtrns_items x where x.bill_id1 = dt.trns_type_code and x.bill_id2 = dt.trns_serial
                      and x.group_code = dt.group_code and x.item_code = dt.item_code)
   and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or it.item_group_code in
        (select group_code from st_group_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))
 group by it.item_group_code, it.item_code, it.name_a
 order by it.name_a

notes: Supplier debit transactions (payments/settlements, VN_TRNSTYPE EFFECT 0, manual only): legacy numbering, header checks, payment-line settlement against open invoices, GL-link balance, posted/paid lock. Wave 3b: legacy LOVs (types, suppliers, cost centres, accounts, payment types, open invoices of the supplier, contracts and bands as cascading lists), type and supplier fixed after insert, payment method list (1 descending / 2 invoice help / 3 debit amount), invoice residual and riyal net value on the payment lines.

rules.where: TRNS_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM VN_TRNSTYPE WHERE EFFECT = 0 AND TRNS_TYPE <> 5 AND NVL(SUM_TRNS, 0) = 0) AND MAIN_TRNS_ID IS NULL AND MAIN_TRNS_SERIAL IS NULL AND NVL(LINK_FLAG, 0) = 0 AND SERIAL IS NULL AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR TRNS_ID IN (SELECT TRNS_ID FROM VN_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD WHERE FLAG = 1 AND PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR (SUPPLIER_ID >= (SELECT FROM_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) AND SUPPLIER_ID <= (SELECT TO_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))

after_save.name: VNDBTRN payment lines, totals, GL link

VN_MAINTRNS.TRNS_ID.lov: select id || ' - ' || description_a d, id r from vn_trnstype where effect = 0 and trns_type <> 5 and nvl(sum_trns, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or id in (select trns_id from vn_trnstype_password where flag = 1 and password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by id

VN_MAINTRNS.SUPPLIER_ID.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 and nvl(s.supplier_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (s.code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and s.code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS.COST_NO.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where nvl(cost_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or cost_code in (select p.cost_code from ac_password_cost1 p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS.DISC_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or account_number in (select p.account_number from ac_password_master p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by account_number

VN_MAINTRNS.PAY_TYPE_CODE.lov: select settel_type_code || ' - ' || settel_type_desc d, settel_type_code r from lc_settel_type order by 2

VN_SUBTRNS.PAY_TYPE_CODE.lov: select settel_type_code || ' - ' || settel_type_desc d, settel_type_code r from lc_settel_type where nvl(non_pay_flag, 0) = 0 order by 2

VN_SUBTRNS.BILL_ID1.lov: select s.bill_id1 || ' / ' || s.bill_id2 || ' - ' || to_char(m.trns_date, 'DD-MM-YYYY') || nvl2(m.supplier_ref, ' - ' || m.supplier_ref, '') || ' - المتبقي ' || to_char(s.total_value - vn_subtrns_payed_value(s.trns_id, s.trns_serial, s.bill_seq)) d, s.bill_id1 r from vn_subtrns s, vn_maintrns m, vn_maintrns h where h.trns_id = :PAGE_TRNS_ID and h.trns_serial = :PAGE_TRNS_SERIAL and m.trns_id in (select id from vn_trnstype where effect = 1) and m.trns_id = s.trns_id and m.trns_serial = s.trns_serial and m.supplier_id = h.supplier_id and m.currency_code = h.currency_code and s.pay_type_code = h.pay_type_code and nvl(s.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and nvl(s.total_value - vn_subtrns_payed_value(s.trns_id, s.trns_serial, s.bill_seq), 0) > 0 order by m.trns_date, s.bill_id1, s.bill_id2

VN_MAINTRNS_ACC.ACC_NUMBER.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or account_number in (select p.account_number from ac_password_master p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by account_number

VN_MAINTRNS_ACC.COST_CENTER.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where nvl(cost_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or cost_code in (select p.cost_code from ac_password_cost1 p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS_ACC.COST_CENTER2.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers2 where nvl(cost_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or cost_code in (select p.cost_code from ac_password_cost2 p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS_SUPP_ACC.ACC_NUMBER.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or account_number in (select p.account_number from ac_password_master p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by account_number

VN_MAINTRNS_SUPP_ACC.COST_CENTER.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where nvl(cost_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or cost_code in (select p.cost_code from ac_password_cost1 p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS_SUPP_ACC.COST_CENTER2.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers2 where nvl(cost_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or cost_code in (select p.cost_code from ac_password_cost2 p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by 2

VN_SUBTRNS_BAND.CONTRACT_ID.lov: select contract_id || ' - ' || desc_a d, contract_id r from vn_contract where supplier_id = (select h.supplier_id from vn_maintrns h where h.trns_id = :PAGE_TRNS_ID and h.trns_serial = :PAGE_TRNS_SERIAL) order by 2

VN_SUBTRNS_BAND.BAND_ID.lov: select cb.band_id || ' - ' || b.name_a || ' - ' || nvl(cb.band_value, 0) d, cb.band_id r from vn_contract_band cb, vn_band b where b.band_id = cb.band_id and cb.supplier_id = (select h.supplier_id from vn_maintrns h where h.trns_id = :PAGE_TRNS_ID and h.trns_serial = :PAGE_TRNS_SERIAL) and cb.contract_id = :PAGE_CONTRACT_ID and check_band_status((select h.supplier_id from vn_maintrns h where h.trns_id = :PAGE_TRNS_ID and h.trns_serial = :PAGE_TRNS_SERIAL), :PAGE_CONTRACT_ID, cb.band_id) = 0 order by 2

VN_SUBTRNS.INV_RESIDUAL.sql: (select s.total_value - vn_subtrns_payed_value(s.trns_id, s.trns_serial, s.bill_seq) from vn_subtrns s where s.trns_id = t.inv_trns_id and s.trns_serial = t.inv_trns_serial and s.bill_seq = t.inv_bill_seq)

VN_SUBTRNS.NET_VALUE_CURR.sql: (select t.net_value * nvl(h.currency_rate, 1) from vn_maintrns h where h.trns_id = t.trns_id and h.trns_serial = t.trns_serial)
